title: A new synthetic approach for high surface area mesoporous silica and its use towards sustainable antifouling materials
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2352-2365
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00047E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Paola Marzullo, Alessandro Presentato, Francesca D'Anna, Vincenzo Campisciano, Rosa Alduina, Enrico Tornatore, Francesco Giacalone, Leonarda Francesca Liotta, Michelangelo Gruttadauria
Silica with high specific surface area (1000 m2 g−1) was obtained by TEOS hydrolysis and resorcinol. The so-obtained silica was modified with a quaternary ammonium salt and entrapped into a PDMS film to give a material with film antifouling activity.
